follow_up.span: The primary outcome was death at 28 days.

notes: Analysis set searched in all three packet sources: cache/corticosteroids-cap-mortality/records.json#/records/7, evidence/held/36942789/europepmc_core.json, and evidence/held/registry/NCT02517489.json. The abstracts state that 800 patients underwent randomization and data from 795 were analyzed, but do not identify the analysis population or explain exclusions; the served intention-to-treat label remains unverified. No held_local/...html full-text source is present in the packet despite the brief. Mortality was assessed at day 28; 8 or 14 days describes treatment duration. Adults with severe CAP admitted to ICU are within the question population; no entry criterion establishes a population outside it.
